description: Compact inventory of the deck — the read to start from: presentationId, title, revisionId, pageSizePt, slideCount and per slide its 0-based index, objectId, layoutObjectId, speakerNotesObjectId and elements[] with each element's objectId, type (shape type / table RxC / image / video / line / group), placeholder role and visible text (truncated to 160 chars). All mutation tools address these object ids, so call this before editing; per-element geometry and full text need get_presentation or get_page.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: list_slides
title: List slides (compact inventory)
